task: Open /home/user/Documents/pattern.kra in Krita. Enable Wrap-Around mode so that seamless-tile painting is active. Additionally, switch Krita's canvas background to the mid-gray checkered pattern. Save the file.

cli_feasibility.translation: Enable wrap-around mode by editing ~/.config/kritarc configuration file
cli_feasibility.reason: ✅ CLI supports view settings by directly modifying the kritarc INI-style configuration file
